name: Faculty:student ratio for UG Engineering & Technology
description: S = approved intake across all years of the programme. Required faculty = S / 20 for UG Engineering & Technology.
explanation_template: UG Engineering & Technology faculty:student ratio is {observed} {unit}; {clause} requires at most {threshold}.

name: Faculty:student ratio for PG Engineering & Technology
description: Required faculty = S / 15 for PG Engineering & Technology.
explanation_template: PG Engineering & Technology faculty:student ratio is {observed} {unit}; {clause} requires at most {threshold}.

name: Faculty:student ratio for Diploma programmes
description: Required faculty = S / 25 for Diploma programmes in Engineering & Technology, Applied Arts, Design and HMCT.
explanation_template: Diploma faculty:student ratio is {observed} {unit}; {clause} requires at most {threshold}.

name: Faculty:student ratio for UG Planning
description: Required faculty = S / 16 for UG Planning programmes.
explanation_template: UG Planning faculty:student ratio is {observed} {unit}; {clause} requires at most {threshold} (S divided by 16).

name: Faculty:student ratio for UG Management
description: Required faculty = S / 25 for UG Management programmes.
explanation_template: UG Management faculty:student ratio is {observed} {unit}; {clause} requires at most {threshold} (S divided by 25).

name: Faculty:student ratio for MBA/PGDM
description: Required faculty = S / 20 for PG Management (MBA/PGDM).
explanation_template: PG Management (MBA/PGDM) faculty:student ratio is {observed} {unit}; {clause} requires at most {threshold} (S divided by 20).

name: Faculty:student ratio for UG Computer Applications
description: Required faculty = S / 25 for UG Computer Applications (BCA).
explanation_template: UG Computer Applications (BCA) faculty:student ratio is {observed} {unit}; {clause} requires at most {threshold} (S divided by 25).

name: Faculty:student ratio for MCA
description: Required faculty = S / 20 for MCA.
explanation_template: MCA faculty:student ratio is {observed} {unit}; {clause} requires at most {threshold} (S divided by 20).

name: Faculty:student ratio for PG Planning
description: Required faculty = S / 10 for PG Planning.
explanation_template: PG Planning faculty:student ratio is {observed} {unit}; {clause} requires at most {threshold}.

name: Faculty:student ratio for UG Applied Arts & Crafts
description: Required faculty = S / 15 for UG Applied Arts & Crafts.
explanation_template: UG Applied Arts & Crafts faculty:student ratio is {observed} {unit}; {clause} requires at most {threshold}.

name: Faculty:student ratio for PG Applied Arts & Crafts
description: Required faculty = S / 15 for PG Applied Arts & Crafts.
explanation_template: PG Applied Arts & Crafts faculty:student ratio is {observed} {unit}; {clause} requires at most {threshold}.

name: Faculty:student ratio for UG Design
description: Required faculty = S / 15 for UG Design.
explanation_template: UG Design faculty:student ratio is {observed} {unit}; {clause} requires at most {threshold}.

name: Faculty:student ratio for PG Design
description: Required faculty = S / 15 for PG Design.
explanation_template: PG Design faculty:student ratio is {observed} {unit}; {clause} requires at most {threshold}.

name: Faculty:student ratio for UG HMCT
description: Required faculty = S / 20 for UG HMCT.
explanation_template: UG HMCT faculty:student ratio is {observed} {unit}; {clause} requires at most {threshold}.

name: Faculty:student ratio for PG HMCT
description: Required faculty = S / 12 for PG HMCT.
explanation_template: PG HMCT faculty:student ratio is {observed} {unit}; {clause} requires at most {threshold}.

name: Faculty establishment meets the calculated requirement
description: Appointed faculty must be at least the establishment calculated from S/ratio, including the Principal/Director post.
explanation_template: Appointed faculty is {observed} times the required establishment; {clause} requires at least {threshold}. Required posts are calculated as S divided by the sanctioned ratio.

name: Professor:Associate:Assistant cadre ratio 1:2:6
description: Cadre mix must satisfy Professor : Associate Professor : Assistant Professor = 1 : 2 : 6 (R = 9) for UG and MCA/MBA/PGDM.
explanation_template: The appointed cadre mix is {result} with the 1:2:6 requirement in {clause}.

name: Principal/Director in position with prescribed qualifications
description: A regularly appointed Principal/Director must be in position; a vacancy beyond 12 months is a penal violation.
explanation_template: A Principal/Director is required by {clause}; a vacancy beyond 12 months attracts penal action under APH 7.4b.

name: Head of Department for each Diploma department
description: Diploma institutions must have one Head of Department per department (APH 6.14, Annexure-5).
explanation_template: A Diploma institution needs one Head of Department per department ({clause}): {result}.

name: A Professor with PhD for every PG course
description: Every PG course needs at least one Professor with a PhD, or an Associate Professor with a PhD if no qualified Professor is available.
explanation_template: Every PG course needs a PhD-holding Professor, or a PhD Associate Professor when no qualified Professor is available ({clause}): {result}.

name: Adjunct faculty within the permitted share
description: Adjunct faculty and Professors of Practice together may not exceed the permitted share of required faculty: 15% generally, 20% for Design and 30% for Planning (APH 6.14d).
explanation_template: Adjunct and Professor-of-Practice posts above the permitted share: {observed} {unit}. {clause} allows 15% of required faculty, 20% for Design and 30% for Planning.

name: Minimum Professors of Practice
description: Professors of Practice must be at least 10% of the required faculty (APH 6.14d).
explanation_template: Professor of Practice shortfall against the 10% minimum: {observed} {unit}. {clause} requires at least 10% of required faculty as Professors of Practice.

name: Faculty salary paid through ECS
description: Salary must be paid through ECS/RTGS/NEFT through a nationalised or scheduled commercial bank.
explanation_template: {observed} {unit} of faculty salaries are paid through ECS/RTGS/NEFT from a nationalised or scheduled commercial bank; {clause} requires {threshold} {unit}.

name: Biometric attendance for all faculty
description: Biometric attendance is mandatory for every faculty member.
explanation_template: {observed} {unit} of faculty attendance is captured biometrically; {clause} requires {threshold} {unit}.

name: Faculty IDs updated on the portal in the same month
description: Faculty additions and removals must be reflected on the AICTE portal in the same month as joining or leaving.
explanation_template: The longest lag between a joining or leaving date and the AICTE portal update is {observed} {unit}; {clause} requires the update in the same month, at most {threshold} {unit}.

name: Faculty appointed on a regular basis
description: Faculty must be appointed on a regular basis; contractual appointments are permitted only briefly in extraordinary circumstances (APH 6.14e). The 90% regular-share threshold is a configurable project assumption because the handbook sets no percentage.
explanation_template: Regular faculty share is {observed}%; {clause} requires regularly appointed faculty and permits contractual appointments only briefly in extraordinary cases. The {threshold}% minimum is a project assumption pending verification.

name: Principal/Director vacancy at most 12 months
description: A Principal/Director vacancy lasting more than 12 months is a penal violation (APH 7.4b).
explanation_template: The Principal/Director post has been vacant for {observed} {unit}; {clause} makes a vacancy beyond {threshold} months a violation.

name: Clear land title or compliant lease
description: Land must have a clear title in the promoter's name, or a lease of at least 30 years with a live lease at least as long as the longest course.
explanation_template: Land title or lease complies with {clause}: {result}.

name: At most three land parcels
description: The campus may comprise at most three plots, with academic, instructional, administrative and amenity areas on one plot.
explanation_template: The campus must comprise at most three plots, with the academic, instructional, administrative and amenity areas on one plot ({clause}): {result}.

name: Plots within two kilometres
description: Plots must be within 2 km of each other (hilly and North-Eastern regions: up to three pieces within 2 km).
explanation_template: Every plot must lie within 2 km of the others, and hill and North-Eastern regions may use up to three pieces within 2 km ({clause}): {result}.

name: Contiguous land parcels
description: Land parcels must be contiguous.
explanation_template: Land parcels must be contiguous ({clause}): {result}.

name: No obstacles across the land
description: No river, canal, railway line, highway or high-tension line may cross the land.
explanation_template: No river, canal, railway line, highway or high-tension line may cross the land ({clause}): {result}.

name: Lease tenure of at least 30 years
description: Leased land must have a registered lease of at least 30 years. Owned land satisfies this rule through its title.
explanation_template: Owned land needs no lease; leased land needs a registered lease of at least 30 years ({clause}): {result}.

name: Live lease covers the longest course
description: The remaining lease must be at least as long as the longest course offered. Owned land satisfies this rule through its title.
explanation_template: The live lease must run at least as long as the longest course ({clause}): {result}.

name: Instructional area for the approved intake
description: Classrooms, tutorial rooms, laboratories, workshops and fixed facilities must meet the Annexure-3 formula for the approved intake.
explanation_template: Instructional area available is short by {observed} {unit}; {clause} requires the full computed area.

name: Built-up area including 25% circulation
description: Built-up area = (instructional + administrative + amenities) + access and circulation of about 25%.
explanation_template: Built-up area falls {observed} {unit} short of the Annexure-3 requirement of instructional, administrative and amenities area plus about 25% access and circulation ({clause}).

name: Administrative area of at least 750 sq. m
description: Minimum administrative area is 750 sq. m for an intake up to 300.
explanation_template: Administrative area is {observed} times the 750 sq. m minimum for an intake up to 300 ({clause}): {result}.

name: Amenities area of at least 500 sq. m
description: Minimum amenities area is 500 sq. m for an intake up to 300.
explanation_template: Amenities area is {observed} times the 500 sq. m minimum for an intake up to 300 ({clause}): {result}.

name: Access and circulation area of about 25%
description: Access and circulation area should be about 25% of the instructional, administrative and amenities area.
explanation_template: Access and circulation is {observed} {unit} of the instructional, administrative and amenities area; {clause} expects about {threshold} {unit}.

name: Library titles for every programme
description: Titles are counted per programme: 100 in the first year for E&T UG, 50 for Diploma and Management/Computer Applications, plus 50 per later year.
explanation_template: Library titles fall {observed} {unit} short of the Annexure-4 requirement of 100 titles in the first year for E&T UG and 50 for Diploma, Management and Computer Applications, plus 50 per later year ({clause}).

name: Library volumes for every division
description: Volumes = 5 x titles x divisions in the first year for UG/Diploma and 4 x titles x divisions for PG.
explanation_template: Library volumes fall {observed} {unit} short of the Annexure-4 requirement of 5 x titles x divisions for UG and Diploma and 4 x titles x divisions for PG ({clause}).

name: Subscribed indexed journals
description: Six subscribed indexed journals per course per level for UG and PG programmes.
explanation_template: Subscribed indexed journals fall {observed} {unit} short of six per course per level for UG and PG programmes ({clause}).

name: Reading-room seating
description: Reading-room seats must be 15% of students (maximum 150) for UG/Diploma and 25% (maximum 100) for PG.
explanation_template: Reading-room seats fall {observed} {unit} short of 15% of students (maximum 150) for UG and Diploma and 25% (maximum 100) for PG ({clause}).

name: National Digital Library membership
description: NDL membership is a desirable requirement under APH 6.54.
explanation_template: National Digital Library membership is required by {clause}: {result}.

name: Computers for the approved intake
description: Computers must satisfy the PC:student ratio with a minimum of 20 PCs.
explanation_template: Computers fall {observed} {unit} short of the PC:student ratio, which carries a minimum of 20 computers ({clause}).

name: Printers at least 5% of computers
description: Printers must be at least 5% of the installed computers.
explanation_template: Printers are {observed} {unit} of the installed computers; {clause} requires at least {threshold} {unit}.

name: Internet bandwidth by approved intake
description: 100 Mbps up to 300 intake, 300 Mbps for 301-600, 500 Mbps for 601-900 and 1 Gbps above 900.
explanation_template: Internet bandwidth falls {observed} {unit} short of the tier for the sanctioned intake (100 Mbps up to 300, 300 Mbps for 301-600, 500 Mbps for 601-900 and 1 Gbps above 900) ({clause}).

name: Language laboratory computers
description: A language laboratory with at least 20 computers, 20 per 300 intake pro rata.
explanation_template: Language-laboratory computers fall {observed} {unit} short of 20 per 300 intake pro rata ({clause}).

name: Anti-ragging committee, squad and CCTV
description: An Anti-Ragging Committee, a squad and CCTV coverage must all be in place.
explanation_template: The Anti-Ragging Committee, squad and CCTV coverage are {observed} of the {threshold} required elements ({clause}).

name: Internal Committee for sexual harassment
description: An Internal Committee with the prescribed composition must be constituted.
explanation_template: An Internal Committee with the prescribed composition is required ({clause}): {result}.

name: Internal Committee annual report uploaded by 30 June
description: The Internal Committee annual report must be uploaded on the portal by 30 June.
explanation_template: The Internal Committee annual report must be uploaded on the portal by 30 June ({clause}): {result}.

name: SC/ST committee
description: An SC/ST committee with five members, at least two SC/ST and at least one woman, must be constituted.
explanation_template: An SC/ST committee of five members, at least two SC/ST and at least one woman, is required ({clause}): {result}.

name: Grievance redressal and Ombudsperson
description: Online grievance redressal, a Student Grievance Redressal Committee and an Ombudsperson must be in place.
explanation_template: Grievance redressal and the Ombudsperson are {observed} of the {threshold} required elements ({clause}).

name: Institution's Innovation Council
description: An Institution's Innovation Council with certificate and registration number must be in place.
explanation_template: An Institution's Innovation Council with its certificate and registration number is required ({clause}): {result}.

name: Barrier-free environment
description: Barrier-free facilities as per CPWD/NBC must be provided.
explanation_template: Barrier-free facilities as per CPWD and NBC are required ({clause}): {result}.

name: Academic Bank of Credits compliance
description: Academic Bank of Credits registration and compliance is mandatory.
explanation_template: Academic Bank of Credits registration and compliance is mandatory ({clause}): {result}.

name: Campus safety and security
description: Campus safety and security arrangements must be in place.
explanation_template: Campus safety and security arrangements are required ({clause}): {result}.

name: Food Safety and Standards Act compliance
description: The institution must comply with the Food Safety and Standards Act for its canteen and mess.
explanation_template: Food Safety and Standards Act compliance for the canteen and mess is required ({clause}): {result}.

name: Digital payments only
description: All payments to and from students must be through digital modes.
explanation_template: All payments to and from students must be through digital modes ({clause}): {result}.

name: All AICTE letters displayed on the website
description: LoA/EoA letters since inception and accreditation status must be displayed on the institution's website.
explanation_template: LoA and EoA letters since inception and the accreditation status must be displayed on the institution website ({clause}): {result}.

name: Mandatory disclosure published
description: The Annexure-18 mandatory disclosure must be published in full on the website and in the brochure.
explanation_template: The Annexure-18 mandatory disclosure must be published in full on the website and in the brochure ({clause}): {result}.

name: Mental-health counselling platform
description: A mental-health counselling platform must be available to students.
explanation_template: A mental-health counselling platform must be available to students ({clause}): {result}.

name: 24x7 women helpline
description: A 24x7 women helpline must be operational.
explanation_template: A 24x7 women helpline must be operational ({clause}): {result}.

name: First aid and medical facilities
description: First aid and medical facilities must be available on campus.
explanation_template: First aid and medical facilities must be available on campus ({clause}): {result}.

name: Potable drinking water
description: Potable drinking water must be available on campus.
explanation_template: Potable drinking water must be available on campus ({clause}): {result}.

name: Waste management and green campus
description: Waste management and green-campus practices must be in place.
explanation_template: Waste management and green-campus practices must be in place ({clause}): {result}.

name: Student safety insurance and group accident policy
description: Student safety insurance and a group accident policy for employees are mandatory.
explanation_template: Student safety insurance and a group accident policy for employees are required ({clause}): {result}.

name: Social and emotional learning mechanism
description: A social and emotional learning mechanism must be in place.
explanation_template: A social and emotional learning mechanism must be in place ({clause}): {result}.

name: Compulsory internship for final-year students
description: A compulsory internship with a published Internship Policy is required for final-year students.
explanation_template: A compulsory internship with a published Internship Policy is required for final-year students ({clause}): {result}.

name: SWAYAM elective credits
description: Up to 40% of courses may be delivered through SWAYAM/MOOCs; the institution must offer the electives.
explanation_template: SWAYAM and MOOC electives must be offered, and up to 40% of courses may be delivered through them ({clause}): {result}.

name: Skilling credits
description: Skilling credits must be offered to students.
explanation_template: Skilling credits must be offered to students ({clause}): {result}.

name: Industry-institution cell
description: An industry-institution cell must be established.
explanation_template: An industry-institution cell must be established ({clause}): {result}.

name: Language laboratory
description: A language laboratory must be available.
explanation_template: A language laboratory must be available ({clause}): {result}.

name: Internal Quality Assurance Cell
description: An IQAC must be constituted with the prescribed affidavit.
explanation_template: An IQAC must be constituted with the prescribed affidavit ({clause}): {result}.

name: No admission beyond the approved intake
description: Admissions must not exceed approved intake plus permitted OCI/NRI and lateral-entry seats.
explanation_template: Admissions exceeded the permitted seats by {observed} {unit}; {clause} imposes a fine of five times the total course fee per excess admission.

name: Student enrolment uploaded before 30 November
description: Student enrolment data must be uploaded on the portal before 30 November.
explanation_template: Student enrolment data must be uploaded on the portal before 30 November ({clause}): {result}.

name: Admissions above 30% of approved intake
description: Admissions below 30% of the approved intake for the preceding five years trigger the reduced-enrolment rule.
explanation_template: The lowest admission rate of the last five years is {observed} {unit}; {clause} treats a fall below {threshold} {unit} of the approved intake as the reduced-enrolment trigger.

name: Affidavit 2 uploaded
description: The portal-generated common Affidavit 2 with its 33 declarations must be uploaded with every application.
explanation_template: The portal-generated common Affidavit 2 with its 33 declarations must be uploaded with the application ({clause}): {result}.

name: Affidavit 2 digitally signed
description: Every upload must carry a digital signature certificate (DSC).
explanation_template: Affidavit 2 must carry a digital signature certificate ({clause}): {result}.

name: Valid Occupancy/Completion Certificate or Form D
description: A valid Occupancy/Completion Certificate, Building Licence or Form D must be uploaded. A partial certificate is accepted for two academic years only.
explanation_template: Occupancy/Completion Certificate: {result}. {clause} requires a valid certificate (Annexure-2.1(iii) cross-refers to it).

name: Valid Fire Safety Certificate
description: A valid Fire Safety Certificate must be uploaded with the application.
explanation_template: A valid Fire Safety Certificate must be uploaded with the application ({clause}): {result}.

name: Structural Stability Certificate for buildings older than 30 years
description: A Structural Stability Certificate is required for buildings older than 30 years and is valid for five years.
explanation_template: A Structural Stability Certificate is required for buildings older than 30 years and stays valid for five years ({clause}): {result}.

name: All mandatory Annexure-2.1 documents uploaded
description: Every mandatory document for the application type must be uploaded before the EoA is downloaded.
explanation_template: Mandatory Annexure-2.1 documents missing from the application: {observed}. {clause} requires every mandatory document for the application type before the EoA is downloaded.

name: Every uploaded document digitally signed
description: All uploads must be digitally signed.
explanation_template: Uploads without a digital signature: {observed}. {clause} requires every document to be digitally signed.

name: No expired certificate uploaded
description: Certificates must be valid on the date of evaluation; an expired certificate is treated as not uploaded.
explanation_template: Certificates that are expired on the reference date: {observed}. {clause} treats an expired certificate as not uploaded.

name: Minimum campus land area
description: Project-only demo threshold for the minimum land area available to the institution. Not an AICTE norm.

name: Minimum built-up area
description: Project-only demo threshold for the constructed area for teaching and support spaces. Not an AICTE norm.

name: Laboratory count
description: Project-only demo threshold for the number of laboratories. Not an AICTE norm.

name: Library volumes (demo)
description: Project-only demo threshold for the library collection. Not an AICTE norm; APH-LIB-VOLUMES carries the handbook rule.

name: Total faculty strength (demo)
description: Project-only demo threshold for total faculty strength. Not an AICTE norm; APH-FAC-ESTABLISHMENT carries the handbook rule.

name: Student-faculty ratio (demo)
description: Project-only demo threshold for students per faculty member. Not an AICTE norm.

name: Faculty with a PhD (demo)
description: Project-only demo threshold for the share of faculty holding a PhD. Not an AICTE norm.

name: Non-negative declared balance
description: Project-only demo requirement that the declared annual balance is not negative. Not an AICTE norm.

name: Qualified faculty share (demo)
description: Project-only demo threshold for the share of professorial-rank faculty. Not an AICTE norm.

name: Built-up area per student (demo)
description: Project-only demo threshold for constructed area per approved seat. Not an AICTE norm.

name: Laboratories per programme (demo)
description: Project-only demo threshold for average laboratories per requested programme. Not an AICTE norm.

name: NAAC grade declared (demo)
description: Project-only demo expectation that a valid NAAC grade is declared. Not an AICTE norm.

name: Mandatory disclosure URL provided (demo)
description: Project-only demo expectation that a mandatory disclosure URL is provided. Not an AICTE norm; APH-ESS-MANDATORY-DISCLOSURE carries the handbook rule.

name: Uploaded documents valid (demo)
description: Project-only demo rule that no uploaded document is rejected, flagged or expired. Not an AICTE norm.

name: Total annual fee band
description: Project-only demo band for tuition plus development plus other fees. Not an AICTE norm.
